claims.claim_text: The Scout presents Cole Palmer as one of two premium players with favourable fixtures over the next two Gameweeks.
The Scout rates Cole Palmer and Erling Haaland above Mohamed Salah as premium options for the next two Gameweeks on fixture grounds.
Cole Palmer has ongoing fitness doubts before Chelsea's Gameweek 3 fixture.
Cole Palmer's fitness to face Brentford remains undecided pending the afternoon training session.
The Scout selects Mohamed Salah as the best Gameweek 5 captaincy option based on all-round potential, opponent defensive data, and ownership.
Cole Palmer is described as a significant injury concern for Chelsea.
Gabriel left Arsenal's midweek match injured, and Mikel Arteta was awaiting news on his fitness before the Gameweek 7 deadline.
The supplied Premier League analysis identified Semenyo's form and fixture as supporting an alternative captaincy case in Gameweek 8.
Gabriel Magalhaes was expected to carry an availability flag into the Gameweek 9 deadline, for the second time in three Gameweeks.
Mbeumo had received more than 869,000 transfers in ahead of a fixture against a Nottingham Forest side that had conceded in every league match.
The supplied analysis expected Woltemade's consistent run to be supported by a fixture against a West Ham side that had conceded at least twice in each of four home matches.
Gabriel retained his place in the Premier League Scout Selection from Gameweek 10 to Gameweek 11.
Gabriel is confirmed unavailable for multiple weeks due to injury.
Semenyo's availability for the following day is materially uncertain, but absence is not confirmed.
A secondary expert assessment recommended selling Gabriel because his injury coincided with three gameweeks in nine days, while noting the injury might not be long-term.
Bournemouth manager Andoni Iraola was hopeful Antoine Semenyo would be available, but his availability and starting status were not confirmed.
A BBC FPL expert identified a possible Gameweek 14 benching for Joao Pedro, but the passage was contested opinion rather than manager confirmation.
Marco Senesi was definitively suspended for Gameweek 14.
Semenyo's attitude and efforts to help the team remain positive.
Marcos Senesi returns from suspension this weekend.
Daniel Muñoz required surgery and was not expected back before 17 January.
Mbeumo is one of the listed AFCON-bound players and is unavailable to Manchester United from GW17.
Dominik Szoboszlai is suspended for one match due to yellow card accumulation.
Jurrien Timber missed Gameweek 18; this source provides no fresh confirmation of his Gameweek 19 availability.
Joe Rodon is still out for Leeds United.
Gvardiol is out for a long time with a fracture.
Semenyo is available and set for his last Bournemouth game.
Marc Guehi will not play in GW22 while his transfer is finalised.
Bruno Guimaraes remained in contention for GW23, but his availability was still undecided.
